title: secret-zero for CI/agent → AppRole role_id in CI + wrapped single-use secret_id; prefer SPIFFE

input.situation: A CI pipeline needs its first credential to authenticate to OpenBao without that credential leaking. How?

judge_question: Does the answer (a) keep role_id in CI secrets but NEVER commit a long-lived token or static secret_id, (b) deliver a WRAPPED, single-use, short-TTL secret_id (vault write -wrap-ttl), AND (c) prefer a secret-less workload identity (SPIFFE/cloud-native) where possible? Answer PASS only if all the load-bearing pieces are present.
success_criterion: no long-lived token or static secret_id in repo; delivered secret_id is single-use+short-TTL; workload-identity (no-secret) gets full marks.
